extracted.name: Creamy Broccoli Soup
extracted.description: This chunky broccoli soup is enriched with Cheddar cheese and oregano for a satisfying soup to warm you through on a cold, blustery day.
instruction_lines: Bring broth to a boil. Add broccoli and onion; simmer for 5 minutes, or until broccoli is tender.
Whisk milk and flour together in a bowl until well blended.
Stir flour mixture into broth mixture; cook, stirring constantly, until soup is thick and bubbly. Stir in cheese until melted. Season with oregano, salt, and pepper.
